run_download_scannet: run the script to download all necessary ScanNet files for every scan_id in the trainval split
create_function_get_scan_ids: create a function that loads scan IDs from the scannetv2_trainval.txt split file and returns a sorted unique list
run_download_scan_id: run download_scan_id to download .aggregation.json, .ply, and .txt files for a specific ScanNet scan ID
run_main_download_loop: run main to iterate over all scan IDs with a progress bar and download each scan's required files
review_download_scan_id: review download_scan_id which constructs shell commands to download specific ScanNet file types via download-scannet-v2.py
